acceptedAnswer.text: AI search visibility is whether LLM-powered search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude can crawl a site, resolve it as a distinct entity, and cite it in generated answers. It is measured as a citation rate, not as a keyword ranking.

mainEntity.name: What does the free check cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Twelve read-only signals: robots.txt policy for AI crawlers, llms.txt presence and structure, JSON-LD entity data, canonical and duplicate handling, citable answer blocks, entity naming consistency, crawlable rendering, sitemap and IndexNow coverage, third-party mentions, structured content density, and competitor citation gaps.

mainEntity.name: How long does a fix take to show results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recrawling of technical signals usually happens within days, but citation rate is a 30-day measurement. A baseline snapshot is taken before the fix and the same queries are re-measured 30 days later.
